description: This source file defines a Spring MVC Controller class 'MatriculaController' responsible for handling HTTP requests related to course enrollment (matriculation). It manages creating enrollments for users in courses, interacting with services and repositories to perform the necessary operations and rendering views accordingly.

classes.name: MatriculaController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller managing course enrollment operations, secured with role-based access control.
